title: Chat answer source block: render dataset provenance (metric and dataset) from query_dataset, not only ObjectQuerySource
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found by the cloud os-dev agent on objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4557 (card cloud#4551, epic cloud#3825). Out-of-scope finding, class b, with a named producer.

## What happens

`DatasetProvenanceSchema` says "An answer renders its source from this block (ADR-0149 D3)". But `plugin-chatbot` `detectAnswerSource` reads only the `ObjectQuerySourceSchema` `source`. So when the ask agent answers through `query_dataset`, the console's "How this was computed" block does not show the metric and dataset the answer used. The text `sourceLine` carries them, but the structured block does not.

## Change

Teach `detectAnswerSource` / `AnswerSource.tsx` to render a `DatasetProvenance` block. Show:
- the metric label and name;
- the dataset;
- the filters;
- the "non-metric reading" label on a fallback.

Test it with a `query_dataset` result fixture.

Seam: spec: `DatasetProvenanceSchema` → ui: `plugin-chatbot` `detectAnswerSource`. Producer: cloud `query_dataset` (PR #4557).
